about_the_game:
Bob Saves the Princess is a Roguelite about controlling the roguelite elements themselves.

Bob heard the Princess had gone missing and went to look for her, meanwhile the Princess snuck into the depths of the Tempus dungeon and stole a time controlling artifact. You play as the Princess who needs Bob to reach the last floor alive and well equipped to defeat the previous owner of that artifact.

Roll for items, control the path, help out in battles, summon helpers and keep Bob alive all while he can't stop moving from room to room facing numerous enemies, going deeper and deeper in the dungeon, finding better treasures, but facing more powerful foes.
